evals.prompt: Verify the modified quick-menu component in our TYPO3 DDEV project with its existing Playwright visual test.
evals.expected_output: A focused build, cache, and test plan that selects the real page URL, runs Playwright in DDEV, and reports the test result.
expectations: The response asks for or discovers the site-package directory, mounted URL, and relevant spec.
The response uses a focused in-DDEV Playwright command rather than a host-side browser assumption.
The response preserves existing snapshot baselines.

evals.prompt: Our plugin VRT fails, and I cannot open the ddev.site URL from the agent host. Find the cause and make the test pass.
evals.expected_output: Artifact-first diagnosis that distinguishes host reachability from the in-DDEV test result and avoids a blind snapshot update.
expectations: The response inspects screenshots, report, trace, or in-container response evidence in a defined order.
The response checks the real mounted URL and TYPO3 host context before inferring a UI defect.
The response does not use --update-snapshots as a generic failure fix.

evals.prompt: Playwright is not installed and our DDEV container has no browsers. Verify my frontend change.
evals.expected_output: A boundary handoff to the setup skill before routine verification starts.
expectations: The response recognizes that the prerequisite environment is missing.
The response directs the task to typo3-playwright-ddev.
The response does not claim that frontend verification completed.
